name: kadmia-mcp

tools.name: get_learner_progress
tools.description: Get your learning progress from Kadmia (requires authentication via KADMIA_LEARNER_ID env var)

tools.name: bookmark_concept
tools.description: Save a JavaScript concept to study later in the Kadmia app. Use this when you encounter something you want to review or don't fully understand yet.

concept.description: The JavaScript concept to bookmark (e.g., 'closures', 'async/await', 'this binding')

note.description: Optional note about why you're bookmarking this

source.description: Whether user bookmarked manually or from a suggestion

tools.name: generate_challenge
tools.description: Generate a JavaScript coding challenge based on a topic or your current code. Challenges are calibrated to your skill level from Kadmia.

topic.description: The JavaScript topic for the challenge (e.g., 'array methods', 'promises', 'closures')

code_context.description: Optional code you're working on to make the challenge relevant

difficulty.description: Difficulty relative to your current level (default: match_level)

tools.name: explain_concept
tools.description: Explain a concept at your skill level. Returns an explanation tailored to your Kadmia progress with examples and links to relevant lessons.

concept.description: The concept to explain (e.g., 'closures', 'the Civil War', 'photosynthesis', 'supply and demand')

context.description: Optional context to make the explanation more relevant (e.g., code snippet, topic area, or what you're studying)

depth.description: How detailed the explanation should be (default: standard)
